sentences.text: William Ray Cyrus -LRB- born August 25 , 1961 -RRB- is an American singer , songwriter and actor .

Having released 12 studio albums and 44 singles since 1992 , he is best known for his number one single `` Achy Breaky Heart '' , which became the first single ever to achieve triple Platinum status in Australia .	Achy Breaky Heart	Achy Breaky Heart
It was also the best-selling single in the same country in 1992 and was translated into more than 100 languages .
Thanks to the video of this hit , the line dance catapulted into the mainstream , becoming a worldwide craze .	line dance	line dance

Cyrus , a multi-platinum selling recording artist , has scored a total of eight top-ten singles on the Billboard Country Songs chart .	Country	Country music	multi-platinum selling recording artist	Music recording sales certification

His most successful album to date is his debut Some Gave All , which has been certified 9 × Multi-Platinum in the United States and is the longest time spent by a debut artist at number one on the Billboard 200 -LRB- 17 consecutive weeks -RRB- and most consecutive chart-topping weeks in the SoundScan era .	Some Gave All	Some Gave All
It is the only album -LRB- from any genre -RRB- in the SoundScan era to log 17 consecutive weeks at number one and is also the top-ranking debut album by a male country artist .
It ranked 43 weeks in the top 10 , a total topped by only one country album in history , Ropin ' the Wind by Garth Brooks .	Garth Brooks	Garth Brooks
Some Gave All was also the first debut album to enter at number one on the Billboard Country Albums chart .	Country	Country music	Some Gave All	Some Gave All
The album has also sold more than 20 million copies worldwide and is the best-selling debut album of all time for a solo male artist .
Some Gave All was also the best-selling album of 1992 in the US with 4,832,000 copies .	Some Gave All	Some Gave All
In his career , he has released 35 charted singles , of which 16 charted in the top 40 .
From 2001 to 2004 , Cyrus starred in the television show Doc .	Doc	Doc (2001 TV series)
The show was about a country doctor who moved from Montana to New York City .	Montana	Montana	New York City	New York City

From 2006 to 2011 , he co-starred in the Disney Channel series Hannah Montana with his daughter Miley Cyrus .	Hannah Montana	Hannah Montana	Miley Cyrus	Miley Cyrus	Montana	Montana	Disney Channel	Disney Channel
As of 2016 , he stars as Vernon Brownmule on the CMT series Still the King .	Still the King	Still the King (TV series)	CMT	Country Music Television
